candidate.answerReason: The three regularly priced tires cost 240−3=237 dollars, so each cost 237÷3=79 dollars. This agrees with D.

methods.label: Subtract and divide
methods.explanation:
The fourth tire cost only \(3\) dollars. Removing that charge leaves the cost of the three regularly priced tires:
\[
240-3=237\text{ dollars}.
\]
Those three tires have the same regular price, so divide their total cost equally among them:
\[
237\div3=79\text{ dollars}.
\]
The regular price of one tire was \(\$79\), choice D.
methods.levelReason: Subtracting a fixed charge and dividing into three equal shares use elementary arithmetic appropriate for AMC 8.
